title: The One Against the North
subtitle: 偏见与公正 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 偏见与公正（做人与做事·公正与偏见）
meta: 主题语境：偏见与公正（做人与做事·公正与偏见）　|　核心词汇：bias　|　正文 327 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bias 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my grandmother was accused of ① a bias she had never stated, and she said the accusing was the whole of the proof. The ② bias, meaning the leaning and not the argument, was never named and was never withdrawn; a bias, she said, is the only opinion that is proved by being denied.

Every ③ bias in that family ran the same way, and the ④ bias against the north, meaning the one about where people came from and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever admitted to. A bias, my mother said, is nine parts inheritance and one part a word you were taught before you could check it; my grandmother said the inheritance is the part that shows.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bias was the whole of the cloth, meaning the diagonal and not the leaning. The ⑥ bias, meaning the cut across the weave and not any of that, is the only way to make a straight thing stretch; a bias, he said, is either something you are accused of or the only word that means both a prejudice and a diagonal. She said the diagonal came first.

By 1975 the ⑦ bias had become a word in a report, and the report had become an argument about who had written the numbers. The ⑧ bias of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was nine years of denial and one admitted word; a bias, she said, is either the leaning against the north or the reason you learned to say where you were from. He said the saying never helped anybody.

The ⑨ bias I remember is the one against the north, which was admitted in 1978 and never corrected. A ⑩ bias, my mother said in 1980, is the only opinion that improves by being admitted; every bias, she said, is a diagonal that has agreed to look like a prejudice. She said the diagonal was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 偏见（指那种倾向，与争论相对）
C. 固定搭配：be accused of a bias 被指有偏见
D. n. 偏见（指家里每一种）
E. n. 偏见（指针对北方那一种）
F. n. 斜裁；斜纹（指布料的斜向裁法）
G. n. 斜裁（抽象：斜着裁这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bias she had never stated
The bias, meaning the leaning and not the argument
bias was the whole of the cloth
The bias, meaning the cut across the weave
the bias had become a word in a report
The bias of the whole thing
A bias, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: be accused of a bias 意为“被指有偏见”，1961 年祖母被指有一种她从没说出口的偏见。
bias 意为“偏见”，指那种倾向而不是争论，它从没被点名，也从没被收回。
bias 指家里每一种偏见，那个家里每一种都朝着同一个方向。
bias 指针对北方那一种（关于人来自哪里的那一种），是唯一有人肯承认的。
bias 意为“斜裁、斜纹”，指布料的斜向裁法，父亲说 bias 就是那块布的全部。
bias 为抽象用法，指斜着裁这件事，是唯一能让一件直的东西产生弹性的方法。
bias 意为“偏见”，到 1975 年这个 bias 成了报告里的一个词。
bias 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的否认和一个承认了的词。
bias 意为“偏见”，我记得的是针对北方那一种，1978 年被承认，却从没被纠正。
bias 为抽象总称，母亲说偏见是唯一会因为被承认而变好的意见。
